3. Verify file auth exists: codex -c cli_auth_credentials_store=file login status

+export function makeAuthJwt(payload: Record<string, unknown>): string {
+  const encode = (value: unknown) => Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(value)).toString('base64url');
+  return `${encode({ alg: 'none', typ: 'JWT' })}.${encode(payload)}.sig`;

+export function captureAuthError(action: () => unknown): Error {
+  let failure: unknown;
+  try {
+    action();

+    failure = error;

+  return failure;

+  let failure: unknown;
+  try {
+    await action();
+  } catch (error) {
+    failure = error;
+  }
+  assert.ok(failure instanceof Error, 'the asynchronous operation must reject');
+  return failure;
